thread:
zoe_support: seeing a sudden 502 spike for hosted-api /v1/generate in us-west-2 starting ~09:12 UTC. error rate ~6% for last 3m. customers noticing timeouts and 502s when doing streaming calls. sample trace id: trace-5d3a1c. stack looks like edge -> auth-proxy -> model-gateway. anyone oncall?

raj_sre: oncall here, looking now. can you paste one curl or a minimal repro?

zoe_support: reproducer (works intermittently):
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -H "Expect: 100-continue" \
  https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/generate -d '{"input":"hello","stream":true}'
```
returns: HTTP/2 502
Upstream response: "upstream reset before headers"

marta_eng: got the edge logs for that trace. envoy reports: 
```
[2026-02-12T09:12:34.123Z] [trace-5d3a1c] envoy upstream reset: rst_stream(0x2) from upstream, stream_id=15, error_code=REFUSED_STREAM
[2026-02-12T09:12:34.124Z] router: upstream request reset, responding 502
```
looks like upstream closed the h2 stream.

dan_platform: checking auth-proxy metrics — we had a spike in authz heartbeats around that time (token-introspection calls fanned out). auth-proxy concurrent h2 streams peaked.

zoe_support: interesting — customers with long-lived streaming + frequent background token refresh see more 502s. could be keepalive/stream exhaustion.

raj_sre: can you attach last 30s of nginx/envoy conn pool stats? also any config change before 09:12?

marta_eng: config diff shows we turned down authz cache TTL from 60s->10s 30m ago to tighten policy. that caused more back-and-forth to authz service.

zoe_support: oh — that would cause many more auth checks per streaming session.

raj_sre: hypothesis: auth-proxy heartbeats caused auth service fanout, auth-proxy saturated its upstream pools; when it failed to answer quickly it reset streams back to edge -> 502. two contributing factors: h2 concurrent stream limits + keepalive pool exhaustion.

marta_eng: envoy debug snippet for auth-proxy shows many PENDING requests queuing for a single connection. e.g.
```
connection pool (host auth-svc:443) active=64 queued=42 max=64
http2: concurrent streams limit reached, rejecting new streams
```

dan_platform: mitigation options:
- rollback TTL change to 60s (reduce fanout)
- temporarily increase h2 concurrent_streams on auth-proxy->auth-svc upstreams
- reduce auth heartbeat frequency on clients (preferable fix)
- add auth-proxy circuit-breaker for introspect path to respond 503 locally rather than 502 upstream surge

zoe_support: can we do a quick mitigation? customers are complaining.

raj_sre: I can hotfix: 1) rollback auth-cache TTL to previous value, 2) add short-lived rate limit on introspect path (200rps) to stop stampede. deploying now.

deploy-bot: starting rollout: auth-proxy-config v2.3.7 -> rollback TTL to 60s (canary 5%).

sre-bot: alert: edge 502 rate dropped from 6% to 0.9% after canary rollout (09:18 UTC).

marta_eng: after rollback we still saw a few straggling 502s tied to long-lived streams that had already been starved. but new sessions look stable.

raj_sre: postmortem notes so far:
- root cause: aggressive auth-cache TTL reduction caused auth-introspect fanout, saturating auth-proxy->auth-svc h2 connection pools and hitting http2 concurrent stream limits -> upstream RST_STREAM -> edge 502.
- contributing: long-lived streaming sessions + token refresh pattern creating overlapping heartbeats.
- immediate mitigations: rollback TTL, rate-limit introspect, increase pool size temporarily.
- long term: add per-tenant backpressure on heartbeat calls, de-dupe introspect queries, instrument h2 stream saturation metrics and create alert.

zoe_support: can we capture reproduction steps for support playbook? I'll paste in ticket replies.

marta_eng: repro steps: (1) start a streaming call that keeps streaming open, (2) set client to refresh token every 8s which triggers token-introspect on server, (3) set auth-cache TTL to 10s on auth-proxy, (4) fire 50 concurrent sessions. observe 502s from edge within 30-60s.

zoe_support: thanks. I'll update customers and add recommended temporary workaround: stagger client heartbeats, or bump auth-cache TTL.

dan_platform: we've also pushed a short-term increase to http2 max concurrent streams on auth-proxy connections to auth-svc (from 100 -> 250) and increased connection pool max from 64 -> 128 for next 30m while we monitor.

raj_sre: monitoring: keep an eye on envoy upstream_retries, upstream_reset, and queued connection counts. created alert: edge-502-fanout-peak if 502_rate > 2% for 5m and queue_length > 30.

zoe_support: closing loop: customers on the tickets report reduced errors, still watching. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

marta_eng: follow-ups: implement introspect de-dup cache (per token) and a fast-path for streaming sessions to defer nonblocking heartbeats. will create a PR.

raj_sre: great. logging this thread to incident tracker and will draft RCA.

zoe_support: noted — I'll add links to tickets and paste the repro.
